Build a portable manifest for an attested model

Source: R/ledger.R
attest_manifest.Rd

A manifest is the certificate reduced to the facts that identify it: the three hashes, what was fitted, and the environment it was fitted in. It is plain data, so it can be written to a file, sent to someone who does not have the model, and compared later.

Usage

attest_manifest(x)

Arguments

x

An attested_model.

Value

A named list.

See also

Other certificates: certificate()

Other ledgers: attest_ledger(), ledger_append(), ledger_entries(), ledger_find(), ledger_verify()

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(1000), x2 = rnorm(1000))
d$y <- factor(rbinom(1000, 1, plogis(d$x1 - d$x2)))
m <- attest_fit(attest_spec(), y ~ x1 + x2, d, engine_glm(), quiet = TRUE)
str(attest_manifest(m))
